title: Air Fryer Conversion Calculator: Oven to Air Fryer Time and Temperature
excerpt: Convert any oven recipe to the air fryer, or back: about 25°F lower and 20% less time, adjusted for the food, its thickness and how full the basket is.
html:
Most recipes are still written for the oven, but an air fryer is a small, powerful convection oven: hot air moves fast around food in a tight space, so it browns and cooks sooner. Converting a recipe means turning the heat down a little and cutting the time. The calculator does the arithmetic and shows you how it got there.

Quick answer: for a recipe written for a conventional oven, set the air fryer about 25°F (15°C) lower and cook for about 20% less time, shaking or flipping halfway. So 400°F for 30 minutes in the oven becomes about 375°F for 24 minutes, checked from 18 minutes.

Air fryer conversion calculator

Choose the direction, enter the temperature and time, and pick the kind of oven, the food, its thickness and how full the basket will be.

Air fryer conversion chart

Starting points for common foods in a basket air fryer, beside the usual oven settings. Use the print button in the calculator for a copy to keep by the stove.

Estimates: models, food size and how full the basket is all change the time. Cook chicken to 165°F and fish to 145°F.

Small, thin foods like fries and nuggets often cook even faster than the 20% rule suggests, which is why the calculator tells you when to start checking, not only how long to cook.

How the conversion works

The calculator uses one plain rule for each kind of oven, so you can check every result yourself:

Recipe written forAir fryer temperatureAir fryer time
Conventional oven (no fan)25°F lower× 0.80 (20% less)
Fan-assisted oven (fan, top and bottom heat)10°F lower× 0.85 (15% less)
Convection oven (fan with its own element)The same× 0.90 (10% less)

Fan-assisted and convection recipes already assume moving air, so they change less. Then the time is adjusted for the food: thin pieces × 0.85, thick pieces × 1.20, and a full basket × 1.15, because crowded food steams instead of crisping. Baked goods go 5°F lower again so the middle sets before the top browns. Temperatures are rounded to the nearest 5 degrees and capped at 400°F, the top setting of most air fryers.

Converting an air fryer recipe to the oven

Run the rule backwards: for a conventional oven, set it about 25°F higher and allow about 25% more time (the air fryer time divided by 0.8). Spread food out on a sheet pan in one layer, and turn it halfway for even browning.

What changes the cooking time

  • Thickness. A thick chicken breast takes much longer than a thin cutlet, whatever the temperature.
  • How full the basket is. Air needs room. Cook in a single layer, or in batches.
  • Your air fryer. Size and wattage vary; small, powerful baskets cook faster than large oven-style models.
  • Frozen or thawed. Frozen food takes longer; follow the package where it gives air fryer times.
  • Preheating. A preheated basket cooks a few minutes faster than a cold one.

Food safety temperatures

Time is a guide; temperature is the test. Check the thickest part with an instant-read thermometer: chicken and turkey 165°F (74°C), ground meat 160°F (71°C), and steaks, pork chops and fish 145°F (63°C), with a 3-minute rest for whole cuts of meat. The meat temperature chart has the full list.

Tips for converting recipes

  • Preheat for 3 to 5 minutes if your model allows it.
  • Use a light coat of oil for crisp results; skip it for frozen fries and nuggets.
  • Shake the basket or flip food halfway through.
  • Use foil or parchment only where air can still move around it; see can you put foil in an air fryer.
  • Start checking from the time the calculator gives, then add minutes as needed.

Air fryer conversion FAQ

How do I convert oven temperature to air fryer?

For a recipe written for a conventional oven, lower the temperature by about 25°F (15°C) and cut the cooking time by about 20%. Check early, and shake or flip halfway.

What is 350°F in an air fryer?

About 325°F, for about 20% less time than the oven recipe. For cakes and muffins, about 320°F.

What is 400°F in an air fryer?

About 375°F. A 30-minute oven recipe becomes about 24 minutes.

What is 425°F in an air fryer?

About 400°F, which is the top setting on most air fryers.

Do I need to preheat an air fryer?

Many models cook better after 3 to 5 minutes of preheating; check your manual. Without it, add a minute or two.

Can I bake in an air fryer?

Yes, in a small pan that leaves room for air. Set it about 30°F below the oven recipe, start checking early, and tent with foil if the top browns too fast.

Why isn’t my air fryer food crispy?

Usually the basket is too full or the food is wet. Pat it dry, use a little oil, cook in a single layer and shake halfway.

Choosing an air fryer? See our air fryer buying guide. Cooking tonight? Try chicken breast in the air fryer or air fryer pork chops, and convert oven dials with the oven temperature converter.
